note: Official-paper source registry. The ingestor downloads ONLY these QP + answer-key PDFs (official origins) and writes verified questions into papers.json. QP URLs are hand-verified once; key URLs are filled by discover-official-papers.py (portal + archive strategies) and HEAD-verified before use. Nothing here is guessed: entries without a verified keyUrl stay status need-key and are never ingested.
